update_reason: initial baseline: the final five-dimension scorecard of phases 10.1/10.2 (docs/EVALUATION.md)
how_to_refresh: python -m eval.compare eval/results/<run>.json --update --reason '<why>' ; review the diff; commit it in the same change as whatever moved the numbers

dimension1_ingredient_recognition.reason: the original vision model (mistral-medium-2505) was retired and the medium tier is unavailable on the free plan; docs/EVALUATION.md section 4
dimension1_ingredient_recognition.noise_evidence: F1 over five runs on the same code and prompt: 0.485, 0.492, 0.489, 0.489, 0.488 (spread 0.007); tolerance 0.010 leaves headroom above that

dimension2_constraint_satisfaction.reason: hard constraints; a hard-constraint violation is a safety failure and is gated absolutely, not by tolerance
dimension2_constraint_satisfaction.noise_evidence: 55/55 in every run since the case set was finalised; tolerance is one case (1/55 = 0.018)

dimension3_match_accuracy.reason: deterministic arithmetic on fixed inputs, no model calls: any disagreement is real

dimension4_freshness_prioritization.reason: d4_13 (the reasoning step overriding a correct freshness ranking) is a known failure at this level
dimension4_freshness_prioritization.noise_evidence: 14/15 in four consecutive runs after the freshness-flag fix; earlier runs ranged 12 to 14; tolerance is one case (1/15 = 0.067)

dimension5_personalization.reason: final choice is a language-model pick, so one case may flap
dimension5_personalization.noise_evidence: 18/18 in the final runs; tolerance is one case (1/18 = 0.056)
